metadata.description: Sequence diagram showing the interaction between services during payment failure

data.diagram:
sequenceDiagram participant Client participant API as API Gateway participant PS as Payment Service participant FD as Fraud Detection participant DB as Payment DB participant Cache as Redis Cache participant Kafka as Kafka Broker Client->>+API: POST /api/v1/payments API->>+PS: Process Payment Request Note over PS: Payment ID: pmt_7x9k2m
Amount: $149.99 PS->>+Cache: GET user:usr_12345 Cache-->>-PS: User Profile (cached) PS->>PS: Validate Payment Details Note right of PS: Validation Passed PS->>+FD: Check Fraud Risk FD->>FD: Analyze Transaction FD->>FD: Check User History FD->>FD: ML Model Inference FD-->>-PS: Risk Score: 0.23 (LOW) PS->>+DB: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE id=? Note right of DB: Connection Pool: 185/200
Query Timeout: 5000ms rect rgb(239, 68, 68, 0.1) DB-->>PS: ⚠️ TIMEOUT (5012ms) Note over PS,DB: Database Connection Exhausted end PS->>PS: Wait 2s (backoff) PS->>+DB: RETRY: SELECT * FROM payments rect rgb(239, 68, 68, 0.1) DB-->>-PS: ❌ Connection Pool Exhausted Note over DB: All 200 connections in use
45 requests waiting end PS->>PS: Circuit Breaker → OPEN PS->>+Kafka: Publish payment.failed event Kafka-->>-PS: Event Published PS-->>-API: ❌ 500 Internal Server Error API-->>-Client: ❌ Payment Failed Note over Client,Kafka: Total Duration: 5178ms
